gaps.title: Half-pixel hairlines
gaps.note: Zara draws 0.5px black around the outline buttons (the newsletter's Subscribe, the product page's Add, the region dialog's second button) and the size selector, 0.5px black separators, field lines at 0.5px #797979 (login) and #757575 (store search, newsletter), filter swatches inside 0.5px #cccccc
gaps.standin: 1px everywhere (`button.secondary`, `menu` and `input` edges +0.5px in both modes)

gaps.title: A light base weight
gaps.note: Helvetica Now Text at 300 for nearly everything (buttons, fields, nav and menu rows, copy, headings, tags, links), 500 only for the current nav row and the selected filter option
gaps.standin: the builder loads 400 to 700 and its lightest weight is normal (400): Work Sans 400 stands in, so most parts read +100 in each mode (`link` +200 at 500)

gaps.title: Capitals at normal tracking
gaps.note: buttons, nav rows, tabs, headings, field labels, tags and filter options set `text-transform: uppercase` with 0 letter spacing
gaps.standin: `buttonCase: uppercase` and `badgeCase: uppercase` add tracking-wider with the caps: +0.65px at 13px on buttons, toggles and segmented items, +0.55px on badges

gaps.title: Capitals beyond buttons and badges
gaps.note: the side nav rows, the menu drawer's tabs, product names and section titles (the h1 to h4 parts), field labels and filter options are all caps, while copy, field values and menu rows stay as written
gaps.standin: case reaches only buttons (`buttonCase`), nav (`navCase` follows it), badges (`badgeCase`) and section labels (`sectionLabels: caps`); `titleStyle: caps` sets 600 with wider tracking

gaps.title: Field label size apart from the control text
gaps.note: the login's label is 12/300 in #6b6b6b above 13/300 values in the 40px field
gaps.standin: labels at the 13px control text in body ink (+1px; ΔE 0.286 light, 0.297 dark)

gaps.title: Heading sizes on their own scale
gaps.note: titles are small and light: the product name (h1) 15/300, the login title 15/300, product names on listings and carousel titles (YOU MAY BE INTERESTED IN) 11/300, all caps, no display scale; the signed-in account pages title at 13/300
gaps.standin: `titleStyle: display` (36/30/24/20px at 400): +21, +19, +13 and +5px

gaps.title: Body text size apart from density
gaps.note: product copy at 12/18 (`body-m`), muted copy and menu rows 12px, under 13px buttons and fields
gaps.standin: 16px body at the default density (+4px); `uiTextSize: 13` reaches only controls (menu rows and muted text +1px)

gaps.title: Sidebar nav row height
gaps.note: the listing's side nav is 20px rows with no padding at 13/300 (the current row 500), beside 32px buttons; the menu drawer's rows are 15/300 at 36px
gaps.standin: 32px rows with 8px padding (+12px, +8px)

gaps.title: Row, tab and segmented ink at rest (full ink at rest)
gaps.note: side nav rows, menu drawer tabs, the VIEW 1 / 2 / 3 items and filter options all rest in #000 (#fff in the shipped dark set); the current one is set apart by weight (nav rows and filter options at 500), a dot (tabs) or opacity (VIEW), never by ink
gaps.standin: idle nav rows, tabs and segmented items in `fg-muted` (ΔE 0.501 light, 0.232 dark)

gaps.title: Toggle buttons with no plate at rest
gaps.note: the filters drawer's sort and size options are bare caps text, 13/300 with no fill, edge or padding; when on they turn 500 with +0.8px tracking and still draw no fill or edge
gaps.standin: toggles wear the outline secondary face (1px edge, 8px padding) and a tone fill when on (ΔE 0.086; on stays 400, -100)

gaps.title: Segmented control with no track
gaps.note: the listing's VIEW 1 / 2 / 3 picker is three bare numerals, 24px tall, no padding, no track, chip or edge; the current one differs only in opacity
gaps.standin: `segmentedTrack: outline` + `segmentedSelected: ring`: a 36px track in a 1px line, 28px ringed chip, 10px padding (+12px, +10px)

gaps.title: Tabs marked by a dot
gaps.note: the menu drawer's WOMAN / MAN / KIDS tabs show the current one with a separate bullet dot beside its label, no underline, fill, weight or ink change; every tab is #000 at 400
gaps.standin: `tabStyle: line`: an underline under the current tab, idle tabs in `fg-muted` (ΔE 0.501); `navWeight: regular` keeps every tab at 400

gaps.title: A display face apart from the title font
gaps.note: the menu drawer's tabs are set in "Times New Roman" at 28/400 with -1.5px tracking, while headings and the rest of the UI are Helvetica Now Text
gaps.standin: tabs in the body face at 13px (-15px, +2.2px tracking with the caps)

gaps.title: Tab padding apart from density
gaps.note: the menu drawer's tabs have no inline padding, 30px tall, spaced by their gap
gaps.standin: 6px padding (+6px)

gaps.title: Tags as plain text
gaps.note: the product cards' NEW (and the other card tags) is 10/300 caps text on a 16px line, with no fill, edge, corners or padding
gaps.standin: `badgeStyle: soft`: the neutral tag is a near-clear square chip (bg ΔE 0.019 light, 0.159 dark), 20px, 7px padding, 11/500 with 0.55px tracking (+4px, +7px, +1px, +200)

gaps.title: Checked checkboxes keep a clear box
gaps.note: the bag's item checkbox stays a white 12px square inside its black outline when checked; the mark sits inside it
gaps.standin: a checked box fills with the check color (ΔE 0.759 on `checkbox.checked` background)

gaps.title: A filled inner square as the checkbox mark
gaps.note: checked draws a 4px black square centered in the 12px box, no tick
gaps.standin: a check glyph; `radioMark: ring` stands in for radios (the store has none)

gaps.title: Menu rows shorter than the density
gaps.note: the product page's size selector lists sizes in 20px rows at 12/300 with 4px padding inside a 0.5px black frame
gaps.standin: 28px rows set in from the frame (`menuInset: inset`, 6px padding): +8px height

gaps.title: Edged overlays with no drop
gaps.note: the region dialog is white inside a 1px #cccccc edge with no shadow; the size selector a 0.5px black frame with no shadow; the filters, size guide and added-to-bag drawers have neither edge nor shadow. The store has no surfaced cards
gaps.standin: Tailwind md under menus and lg under dialogs (`dialog` and `menu` shadow 0 → 2 layers)

gaps.title: Dark overlays kept on the page tone
gaps.note: the shipped `zds-theme--dark` set (the store itself has no dark mode) keeps dialogs and menus on the #000 page, set apart by their edge only (#666666, 0.5px white), no shadow
gaps.standin: dialogs and menus on the raised step, oklab L 0.181 (ΔE 0.181)

gaps.title: Neutral links at body weight
gaps.note: the bag's inline links are #000 at 300, the copy's weight, underlined
gaps.standin: `linkColor: neutral` sets 500 (+200)

gaps.title: Quiet buttons with less inline padding
gaps.note: the listing's FILTERS is bare caps text with no padding, beside filled buttons padded 12px
gaps.standin: quiet buttons share the filled padding (10px at the default density)

gaps.title: Field height between one step and tall
gaps.note: the login's email field is 40px beside 32px buttons
gaps.standin: `inputHeight: step` 36px (-4px in both modes)

gaps.title: Light-mode ink lightness
gaps.note: pure #000 for text, headings, the primary fill, outline edges, checks, links and menu rows
gaps.standin: `fg` at oklch 0.241 (ΔE 0.241 on 20 parts, the preset's most common off row)

gaps.title: Dark-mode ink lightness
gaps.note: the shipped `zds-theme--dark` set's pure #fff ink (the store has no dark mode)
gaps.standin: `fg` at oklch 0.957 (ΔE 0.043)

gaps.title: Muted ink lightness
gaps.note: the palette's mid gray #757575 (oklch 0.56) in light, lighter than `fg-muted`, and #929292 (0.66) in the shipped dark set, darker; the login's field label #6b6b6b
gaps.standin: `fg-muted` at 0.502 / 0.768 (ΔE 0.061 light, 0.108 dark)

gaps.title: Outline buttons and menus edged in full ink
gaps.note: Zara's outline buttons and the size selector's frame are 0.5px #000 (#fff in the shipped dark set), while field lines are #797979 and the dialog's edge #cccccc
gaps.standin: `controlEdge: strong` puts button edges at oklch 0.60 (ΔE 0.600); menus take the surface line, L 0.925 (ΔE 0.925)

gaps.title: Surface hairline strength (darker)
gaps.note: the region dialog's 1px #cccccc edge (oklch 0.84) in light and #666666 in the shipped dark set
gaps.standin: the surface line at L 0.925 / 0.281 (ΔE 0.080 light, 0.230 dark)

gaps.title: An accent that changes per mode
gaps.note: the focus and info blue is #0170e9 in light and #0084ff in the shipped dark set
gaps.standin: `preserveSeed` keeps #0170e9 in both modes (ΔE 0.059 on the dark focus ring and field line)
